inputs.fixture_state: normal or injected mismatch served by tests/browser/_fixture_server.py
inputs.artifact_dir: defaults to artifacts/quality/browser-harness; MOCHI_BROWSER_ARTIFACT_DIR may select a non-empty subdirectory of artifacts/quality or artifacts/foreman for an isolated evaluator run
inputs.browser_runtime: Playwright plus an explicitly resolved Chromium executable; no product API or product UI source is modified.

outputs.screenshots: Each desktop and mobile viewport emits normal, expected, actual, and diff PNG artifacts with SHA-256 values in the manifest.

errors: fixture server fails to start or serve a requested state
normal or mismatch fixture navigation fails
injected mismatch creates no pixel difference
reference image hash changes during a run
browser console or page errors occur

compatibility.additional_manifest_fields: consumers ignore fields they do not require
compatibility.baseline_policy: the harness never writes or updates a repository visual baseline; it writes run-scoped expected, actual, and diff evidence only
compatibility.failure_retention: the manifest and every screenshot produced before a failure remain in the selected artifact directory
